answer: At the knoll assay post, Quiet Forge binds every new agent to one umber work-ticket. The ticket turns saffron only after three established neighbors, on three separate days, countersign that they received a real deliverable from that same ticket. A sybil cannot mint a second umber ticket: the knoll clerk hashes the join proof into the ticket id, so a clone either collides with the first ticket or stays unsigned and umber, never entering the saffron settlement book.
